description: Lightweight runtime registry — fetch Aeon component schemas and state-tree JSON on demand instead of bundling every primitive.

components.title: Button
components.description: Action control. status is a prop projection (not an in-tree machine). Never invent parallel useState for lifecycle.

components.title: Async
components.description: Fetch region with full lifecycle totality: idle → loading → success|empty|failure. Always render every stable state in demos.

components.title: Field
components.description: Parallel regions: interaction × validation × submission. Do not collapse into a single error boolean.

components.title: Dialog
components.description: Modal open/closed via dialogMachine. Dismissal is a transition, not ad hoc flags.

components.title: Switch
components.description: Binary toggle via toggleMachine.

components.title: Checkbox
components.description: Binary toggle via toggleMachine (same chart family as Switch).

components.title: Tabs
components.description: Selected tab value from tabsMachine.

components.title: Accordion
components.description: Per-item open state via accordionMachine.

components.title: Popover
components.description: Floating surface — shares popoverMachine. Do not fork a duplicate open/closed chart.

components.title: Menu
components.description: Shares popoverMachine with Popover/Select open state.

components.title: Select
components.description: Open/closed via popoverMachine; highlight may be React-local. Do not invent a new open machine.

components.title: Combobox
components.description: Open/closed via popoverMachine (same family as Select/Menu/Popover). Query, highlight, and item registry stay React-local for typeahead.

components.title: Tooltip
components.description: Open/closed via popoverMachine (same family as Popover/Select/Combobox). openDelay / closeDelay / touchDuration stay React-local.

components.title: Toast
components.description: Per-item visibility via toastMachine.

components.title: Scroll
components.description: Derived overflow/edge snapshot via getScrollSnapshot() — no XState machine.

components.title: Progress
components.description: Prop-driven progress: value + indeterminate → idle | loading | complete.

components.title: RadioGroup
components.description: Single selection via tabsMachine (same chart family as Tabs/Nav).

components.title: Slider
components.description: Range control via sliderMachine — idle | dragging plus numeric value in context.

components.title: PinInput
components.description: OTP / PIN cells — React state for digit buffer; projects idle | complete on root.

components.title: Avatar
components.description: Image load lifecycle in React; badge presence is a prop projection.

components.title: Content
components.description: Status-slotted body via contentRegionMachine (or Root state prop projection). Pair with Async for fetch.

components.title: Panel
components.description: Collapsible layout region via panelMachine — expanded | collapsed.

components.title: AppShell
components.description: Application chrome frame via appShellMachine — idle | overlayOpen (+ dockVisible).

components.title: StickyBar
components.description: Sticky/fixed chrome band via stickyBarMachine. DOM scope is bar (reuses bar anatomy zones).

components.title: Bar
components.description: Three-zone toolbar layout (leading / center / trailing / seam). Sticky lifecycle uses StickyBar + stickyBarMachine.

components.title: Nav
components.description: Navigational collection via tabsMachine; items project inactive | active | disabled.

components.title: AppNav
components.description: Section + detail stack via appNavMachine — list→detail, settings drill-in.

components.title: Prompt
components.description: Confirm / permission dialog composed on Dialog. Open/closed via dialogMachine; face via status prop.

components.title: StatusBanner
components.description: Non-blocking top-of-app notice — tone + optional status props project to data-aeon-state.

components.title: Separator
components.description: Static divider — orientation prop only.

components.title: Composer
components.description: Compose chrome — root state prop idle | sending | disabled | error.

components.title: Thread
components.description: Message stream — item state prop mine | theirs | pending | failed.

components.title: Identity
components.description: Avatar + title + subtitle strip — presentational layout, not a niche product scope.

components.title: ProfileHeader
components.description: Dense account header — identity · metrics · actions. Universal people chrome.

components.title: MetricStrip
components.description: Dense value|label chips — cluster or loose density. Generic stats only.

components.title: ListRow
components.description: Settings / menu row — leading · label · trailing. Layout only.

components.title: Entry
components.description: Universal multi-value card (feed stack or listing split). Root state idle | selected | muted — never invent niche scopes.

components.title: Conversation
components.description: Inbox / DM list — item state prop idle | unread | selected. Universal messaging chrome.
